note: Numbers are starting targets. Change them with a recorded reason (docs/adr), never silently.

hazards.hazard: Undetected loss or corruption of position data
hazards.effect: Fly-away or landing far from home

hazards.hazard: Recovery action needs a capability that has failed
Not enough energy for the chosen recovery
Health stack stops or overruns without anyone noticing

hazards.effect: Failure can't be reproduced or explained

hazards.hazard: Health monitor reads the fault ground truth
hazards.effect: Results look perfect but prove nothing

requirements.text: The system shall declare GPS stale within 0.5 s after GPS updates stop, with the stale timeout set to 0.3 s.
The system shall not mark GPS FAILED for drift on a single residual; the velocity-consistency and position residuals shall both agree. Timeouts and frozen output are exempt.
With vision odometry fitted, the system shall detect a GPS drift of 0.5 m/s or more within 20 s with probability of at least 0.95 (evaluation set, configuration B).
The false alarm rate in fault-free flight shall be below 0.1 per flight hour (evaluation set).
Following a confirmed critical navigation fault, the system shall isolate the sensor and request a defined degraded or contingency mode within 1.0 s.
The recovery manager shall select only actions whose required capabilities are available in the current health state.

Return shall be selected only when the twin-predicted energy at landing exceeds the reserve (15 %) and the predicted loaded voltage stays above 3.40 V per cell (just above the autopilot's 3.35 V forced-landing threshold).
The AERIS step shall run at 50 Hz with fewer than 0.1 % of steps exceeding the 20 ms period on the reference host.
If AERIS stops responding for 1 s, the vehicle shall continue under the autopilot's own failsafes.
The system shall record a timestamped event for each detection, diagnosis (with its evidence) and recovery action.
Each run shall store a manifest sufficient to regenerate it (code version, config hash, scenario, seed).
The AERIS core shall not import the simulator or the fault injector, and shall not receive fault ground truth.
